source_definition: The source gives d≥1, an explicit binary activity array of length 2ᵈ defining T, and k≥0. Its outputs are subsets X⊆T of size at most k that dominate the cube graph induced by T, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: The target gives a hypercube dimension ℓ≥1 in unary, positive integer weighted ordered demands between distinct vertices, and a nonnegative integer K. A valid output is a partial matching whose demand-weighted shortest-route cost is at most K/2. Static edges cost 1, matching edges cost 1/2, and each route changes link medium at most twice. Every vertex has one switch port; there are no capacity or congestion constraints. Return NO-SOLUTION if no matching qualifies.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
